title: GroupsConfig::names field undocumented as wildmat patterns
description: In crates/transit/src/config.rs, the GroupsConfig struct (line 347) has a field 'names: Vec<String>' with no doc comment. The field name 'names' strongly implies these are literal group names (like 'comp.lang.rust'), but they are actually wildmat filter patterns that support wildcards ('comp.*', '\!alt.binaries.*') and follow GroupFilter semantics (first-match-wins, default-deny). A reader configuring the system who writes names = ['comp.lang.rust', 'sci.math'] will expect exact-name behavior, not realizing these are matched against patterns. A doc comment explaining that these are wildmat patterns, referencing GroupFilter semantics, and giving a brief example of wildcard usage would prevent misunderstanding. Compare to how ExternalPinServiceConfig::groups (line 383) does explain the glob semantics.
